lines.zh: 我跑起来，步子很小很快。
lines.en: I run with small, quick steps.
I am light enough to barely leave prints.
I turn my head as I run.
I know these ferns.
I slip between the grass stems.
My tail is held straight out.
When I stop, the grass closes over me.

lines.zh: 我沿着虫子多的地方走。
lines.en: I keep to where the insects are.
I cross a patch of moss.
I walk on my toes.
Triassic shrubs are low to me.
I run a short way, then stop.

lines.zh: 我沿着倒木的边走过去。
lines.en: I go along the edge of a fallen log.

lines.zh: 我贴着石缝走，避开沙地。
lines.en: I hug the rock crevices, avoiding sand.
I crouch with both hands hanging.
My eyes never settle.
Something is under the leaf.

lines.zh: 我纹丝不动，只有尾巴尖在抖。
lines.en: I hold perfectly still except for a twitching tail tip.
I tilt my head to listen.
This patch is safe.
I lift one foot.
My neck is thin, my head light.
I am picking which insect.
If I stay still, the insects come.
Too many sounds here.
My light frame sinks lower.

lines.zh: 我的前爪搭在枯叶上，几乎没声。
lines.en: My foreclaws rest on dry leaves, almost silent.

lines.zh: 我后腿绷紧，随时要窜出去。
lines.en: My hind legs are cocked, ready to bolt.

lines.zh: 你站起来，比整丛蕨还高。
lines.en: You stand taller than the whole fern patch.

lines.zh: 你站在这儿，虫子都跑了。
lines.en: With you standing there, the insects are gone.
I am a bit close to you.
I do not intend to bite you.
There is an insect by your foot.
One move and I am gone.

lines.zh: 我偏着脑袋，用一只眼看你。
lines.en: I cock my head and fix one eye on you.

lines.zh: 这里是我的地盘，小小的。
lines.en: This is my ground. It is small.
What are you looking at?

lines.zh: 我退半步，细腿绷得笔直。
lines.en: I back half a step, slender legs stiff.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，又移开视线。
lines.en: I watch your hand, then look away.

lines.zh: 我退开一步，轻盈的骨头不硬碰。
lines.en: I step back; these light bones do not clash.
I leapt away, and it still hurts.
One of my legs is lame.

lines.zh: 我的叫声又细又短，像虫鸣。
lines.en: My cry is thin and short, like an insect's.

lines.zh: 我钻进草丛，只留尾巴在外面。
lines.en: I dive into the grass, only my tail showing.

lines.zh: 我的细腿折了半截，站不住。
lines.en: My thin leg is half broken; I cannot stand.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，尾尖还在抖。
lines.en: I curl up, tail tip still trembling.
I retreat slowly.
I dare not run.
Blood on the leaves.

lines.zh: 我撑着站起来，腿在打颤。
lines.en: I push myself up, legs shaking.
Is that an insect?
I only chase bugs that run.

lines.zh: 这块虫壳太硬，我咬不碎。
lines.en: This insect shell is too hard to crack.

lines.zh: 你把虫干放低，我走近一步。
lines.en: You lower the dried insect, and I take a step.
I will take a nip.

lines.zh: 我轻得像一阵风，跑得很快。
lines.en: I'm light as wind and quick on my feet.
That smells wrong.

lines.zh: 你指缝里还夹着虫干吗？
lines.en: Is there more dried insect between your fingers?

lines.zh: 我这么轻，跑起来追得上虫。
lines.en: Light as I am, I run down insects.
You open your hand: only an empty palm.

lines.zh: 你碰了我一下，我差点翻倒。
lines.en: You brush me, and I nearly tip over.
I am knocked aside.
My bones are too thin.
I roll and get up.
Your feet are too large.
I dodge quickly.
I was nearly trodden on.

lines.zh: 你踢到我，我翻了半个跟头。
lines.en: You kick me, and I tumble half a somersault.
I slip away from your feet.

lines.zh: 你靠近，我的尾巴就竖起来。
lines.en: As you come close, my tail rises.
We meet in the ferns.

lines.zh: 她跑在前头，我追得气喘。
lines.en: She runs ahead, and I chase her panting.
We chase a short way.
The grass here is tall enough.
It tilts its head at me.
In the ferns, we crouch side by side.
A clutch of eggs, hidden under leaves.

lines.zh: 体重轻，跑起来像一阵风。
lines.en: So light that I run like a gust.
We hide first.
Then we run our separate ways.
Such a small thing. Let me look.
I nudge it with a claw.
An insect. Good.
Not edible.
I take it and run.
It fell.
That is not mine.
You pick it up.

lines.zh: 我叼起一粒种子，又掉了。
lines.en: I pick up a seed and drop it again.
I run light, my feet make no sound.
There is an insect.
I saw it move.
Right there.

lines.zh: 我藏在蕨叶后，只露一只眼。
lines.en: I hide behind a fern, one eye showing.

lines.zh: 一步，我量好了，正要起跳。
lines.en: One stride, measured; I am about to spring.

lines.zh: 我等那只虫再爬近一点。
lines.en: I wait for the insect to crawl nearer.
It is still there.
There — I saw it move.

lines.zh: 我三步跨过空地，冲它去了。
lines.en: Three strides cross the clearing, straight at it.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的小快腿，专抓虫子。
lines.en: Triassic quick-legs, built for insects.
Got it.
No.
That was not an insect.

lines.zh: 我退到石头后，只露出头。
lines.en: I retreat behind a stone, head only.

lines.zh: 我挪半步，停一下，再挪半步。
lines.en: Half a step, a pause, then half a step more.

lines.zh: 虫还在爬，我的头已经压低了。
lines.en: The insect still crawls; my head is already low.

lines.zh: 风把它的味道送到我鼻尖。
lines.en: The wind brings its scent to my snout.
I've got my eye on the bug by your foot.
I freeze, hind legs bending slowly.
I am this light. I run without a sound.
So do I.
This close.
I lift my forefoot gently.

lines.zh: 我从石头上落下，正好到它背后。
lines.en: I drop from the stone right behind it.
Missed.
It is gone.
I will look again.
There are more here.
Found it, right under the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，咬住那只大虫。
lines.en: I jump and catch the big insect.
It still struggles, so I bite harder.

lines.zh: 我咬住虫子，甩头把它扯断。
lines.en: I bite the insect and shake it apart.
Swallowed.
I caught only air.
I get one bite; there is too little meat.
I pin it with a foreclaw.
It is far smaller than I.
Another one.
That will do for now.
I lick the insect juice from my lips.
Going.
Insects and small beasts are mine.
I see another.

lines.zh: 我跑起来步子很小很快，不留印。
lines.en: I run in quick little steps that leave no print.

lines.zh: 我从落叶堆里钻出来，虫子在跳。
lines.en: I emerge from the leaf litter while insects scatter.
First I crouch and stay still.
The grass is tall, good cover.
I hear many small sounds.
There is dew on the ground.
I do not know this patch.
There is something large far off.
I raise my head slowly.
The wind is good.
I shake my slender legs free of dirt.
I am light enough to walk on dry leaves.
There is cover here.
I do not call.
Let me look first.
A worm crawls past.
My first meal.

lines.zh: 我站定，抖了抖背上的土。
lines.en: I stop and shake the dirt off my back.
Fire touches me and my hide shrinks.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，摔得发懵。
lines.en: I fall from a height and lie stunned.

lines.zh: 浅水没到我的胸口，我拼命蹬腿。
lines.en: Shallow water reaches my chest, and I kick desperately.
The blast throws me into the brush.

lines.zh: 箭从我的腿骨间穿过去。
lines.en: An arrow passes between the bones of my leg.
My legs suddenly will not obey.
Too hungry to stand.
The flash leaves me rigid.
There is no ground below.
